description: NaCo₂O₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.76 Å. There are four inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.98 Å) Co-O bond lengths. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.95 Å. In the third Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.98 Å) Co-O bond lengths. In the fourth Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.95 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Co atoms to form distorted ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Co atoms to form distorted ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Co atoms to form ONaCo₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with five ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Co atoms to form ONaCo₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with five ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Co atoms to form ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Co atoms to form ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five ONaCo₃ tetrahedra, corners with four ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaCo₃ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Co₂ trigonal bipyramid.
